name: set_profile
title: Set profile
description: Create or update a saved meeting profile (source of truth: <NARUMI_HOME>/profiles.json). Only the keys you pass change; omitted keys keep their current value (a new profile starts with an empty config, no scope / engagement and no export destinations). `scope` here is the default value stored in the profile — not a scope selector — and, like `engagement`, accepts null to clear it. `config` keys are merged into the stored config (a key set to its null-clearing value where the type allows, e.g. self_name=null or minutes_model=null, clears it). minutes_model, when present, is a whole-object text minutes override validated against the enabled connection, pinned revision, verified model catalog, authentication and resulting policy. Codex requires subscription_ok or api_ok; Anthropic/OpenAI API require api_ok; numeric-loopback Ollama with verified local models may use local_only. Supported text adapters are listed in capabilities.minutes_model_providers; unknown models and Claude Agent SDK generation are not selectable. Parameters are closed per provider, max_tokens is restricted to 1..32768 and a known model output limit is also enforced. When omitted, token-limited adapters use min(4096, known model limit), or an application limit of 4096 when unknown, without populating unknown model capabilities. Omitted minutes_model retains the saved value; old profiles without it retain legacy llm_provider behavior. It does not select models for other stages. `export_destinations` replaces the stored list (registry names from list_export_destinations); they run automatically when a meeting using this profile finishes processing. make_default=true makes this the profile applied when start_recording / import_recording omit `profile` (exactly one profile is default at a time). Returns the full stored profile. `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the original result. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: invalid_argument (bad name or config, unknown export destination), policy_violation (the stored config would select engines / providers not allowed by its external_send_policy — validated at save time, nothing is silently downgraded), engine_unavailable (config names an engine / provider not registered or its runtime is unavailable), configuration_conflict, authentication_required, model_unavailable, internal.

name.description: Profile name to create or update.

config.description: Config defaults merged into the stored config; omitted keys keep their current value.

scope.description: Default affiliation scope stored in the profile (not a scope selector); null clears it. Omit to leave unchanged.

engagement.description: Default engagement label stored in the profile; null clears it. Omit to leave unchanged.

export_destinations.description: Automatic export destinations (registry names from list_export_destinations). Replaces the stored list.

make_default.description: Make this the default profile (default false). The previous default loses is_default.

profile.description: Full stored profile after the update.
